title: Berlin Nebenkostenabrechnung - Quick Summary
items: **Two twelve-month clocks decide the bill.** A calendar-year 2025 statement must reach you by 31 December 2026 or the landlord loses any top-up (§ 556 BGB). From the day it lands you have twelve months to object in writing.

**Berlin publishes what each line normally costs.** The official Betriebskostenübersicht for billing year 2024 puts cold costs at €1.93 per m² and month and heating plus hot water at €1.50, with a range for every one of sixteen lines.
**The big four cold lines are insurance, property tax, water and waste.** Together they are more than half of a normal cold bill. Street cleaning and snow clearing average three cents each.

**This is the first statement with the reformed Grundsteuer.** Berlin kept the total the same, but the line rises in Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg, Prenzlauer Berg, Mitte and Tiergarten and falls in Wedding, Tempelhof and Reinickendorf. Ask for the Grundsteuerbescheid if yours moved.

**Some things can never be on it.** Administration, repairs, maintenance, bank charges, the owner’s legal insurance, and since 1 July 2024 the cable TV subscription. A lump sum under sonstige with nothing behind it is the first line to query.
**Heating must be split by consumption.** At least 50 and at most 70 per cent by meter. A pure square-metre split gives you a flat 15 per cent cut on that line.
**You may see the file.** Ask in writing for Belegeinsicht on the named lines and the distribution key, check the square metres, the billing unit, vacancy and invoice dates.
**Pay the undisputed part on time.** Say in the same message which lines are disputed. Every district funds free tenant advice if the numbers are large.
